title: HTTP methods trace event state
description: Shape of the `state` field for http-methods trace events.

base.description: The collection URL this server exposes, e.g. '/orders'.

resources.description: Everything stored on the server right now, one entry per resource.

fields.description: The stored representation, in a stable display order.

mark.description: How the current request touched this resource.

cached.description: URLs the client holds a fresh cached response for.

request.description: The request being processed (absent before the first one).

safe.description: Whether this method promises not to change server state.

idempotent.description: Whether N identical calls are defined to leave the same state as one.

cacheable.description: Whether a response to this method may be reused by default.

body.description: The request body as sent; empty for methods that carry none.

response.description: The answer produced for the current request.

status.description: HTTP status line ('200 OK', '405 Method Not Allowed'), or 'pending' while the request is still being processed.

hasBody.description: Whether the response carries a body at all.

fromCache.description: Whether the client answered from its own cache instead of the server.

location.description: The Location header of a created resource, or null.

allow.description: The Allow header, sent with OPTIONS and 405; empty otherwise.

counters.description: Running totals for the whole run.

unsafeReads.description: Requests sent with a safe method whose handler wrote anyway.
